import sys, os, io, hashlib
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: os.environ.pop(k, None)
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend')
from dealroom_sign import placement
from dealroom_sign.tests import placement_r24_review_cases as R24
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement import TWO
rc = R24.rc; X = 72
FLEET = [(240, 'FLEET TEST CO.', False, X), (270, 'By:', True, X), (300, 'Date:', True, X)]
AFF = [(520, 'HARBOR LIGHT GROUP, INC.', False, X), (560, 'By:', True, X), (600, 'Date:', True, X)]
def show(label, pages, people):
    r = placement.place(rc.pages_pdf(pages) if not isinstance(pages, bytes) else pages, people, model_client=Mock())
    print(label, '|', r['status'], r['reason_code'], [(f['signer'][:3], f['type'], f['page'], f['evidence']['line'], f['confidence']) for f in r['fields']])
pat = dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)
with patch('httpx.Client.send', Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http'))):
    for head in ('For and on behalf of the Recipient', None, 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.'):
        for aff in (False, True):
            rows = FLEET + ([(340, head, False, X)] if head else []) + [(370, 'Signature:', False, X), (382, 'Pat Smith, CEO', False, X)] + (AFF if aff else [])
            show(f'sig_text head={head} aff={aff} recital=parsed', [list(rc.RECITALS['parsed']), rows], [pat])
    # filled thin rectangles as rules (Word-style) for Pat's own block; Fleet + affiliate drawn
    def mixed(fill_own):
        out = io.BytesIO(); c = canvas.Canvas(out, pagesize=(612, 792)); c.setFont('Helvetica', 10)
        for y, t in rc.RECITALS['parsed']: pass
        for row in rc.RECITALS['parsed']:
            c.drawString(row[3], 792 - row[0] - 8, row[1])
        c.showPage(); c.setFont('Helvetica', 10)
        for y, text, rule, x in FLEET + AFF + [(340, 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.', False, X)]:
            c.drawString(x, 792 - y + (2 if rule else -8), text)
            if rule: c.line(x + 10 + c.stringWidth(text, 'Helvetica', 10), 792 - y, x + 218, 792 - y)
        c.drawString(X, 792 - 370 + 2, 'By:')
        if fill_own: c.rect(X + 28, 792 - 370 - 0.5, 190, 0.75, stroke=0, fill=1)
        else: c.line(X + 28, 792 - 370, X + 218, 792 - 370)
        c.drawString(X, 792 - 382 - 8, 'Name: Pat Smith'); c.drawString(X, 792 - 394 - 8, 'Title: CEO')
        c.showPage(); c.save(); return out.getvalue()
    show('own block By: as stroked line', mixed(False), [pat])
    show('own block By: as filled 0.75pt rect', mixed(True), [pat])
    show('own block By: as filled rect, both signers', mixed(True), [TWO[1], pat])
